labels: enhancement

---

## Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem. Example: "I wish Scout OSS could detect X technology..."

## Describe the Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe Alternatives

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Use Case

Describe the scenario where this feature would be useful. For example:
- "Scanning e-commerce sites to detect Shopify..."
- "Analyzing documentation sites for metadata completeness..."

## Proposed Implementation (Optional)

If you have ideas about how to implement this feature, share them here. For example:
- New detection rule in `technology.py`
- New extractor module
- Schema extension

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for duplicates
- [ ] I have checked the [ROADMAP](../../ROADMAP.md) to see if this is already planned
- [ ] I have described the use case clearly
